description: AIwander CPC Toolbelt for Codex/ChatGPT: Hands MCP + Cache path skills + optional Workflow / Manager / Voice. Does not include Autonomous.

interface.shortDescription: Hands automation + Cache path skills for Codex
interface.longDescription: AIwander CPC Toolbelt for Codex and ChatGPT. Bundles Hands MCP (stdio, ${HANDS_HOME} filled at install time), Cache path skills, and optional Workflow / Manager / Voice guidance. Hands home is HANDS_HOME, else CPC_ROOT, else the per-user AIWander/Hands directory. Programmer is directed-only and not default-wired. Autonomous is not included.
defaultPrompt: Call hands_setup_status, then set up CPC Toolbelt for this machine
Use Hands to automate a browser task
